body: The tutorial is out of date, as you can see at the top of the page, the documentation would need to clarify though as these are intended to be required and not optional

Thanks for clarifying that, I assumed that at least the class docs are up to date. Is there a reason why I wouldn't want to use the default values for these? If so it would also be nice to add an explanation to the documentation or to the tutorial.

IMO for me as someone new to creating plugins it is confusing to provide no default implementation, because I wouldn't know what values to choose other than the defaults.

Also, most other virtual functions I know from godot just do nothing if you don't implement them, rather than result in an error (even `_get_format_version` and `_can_import_threaded` on the same class). Or look at `EditorPlugin`, which has 24 virtual methods and none are required.

It would be good to see at a glance which methods are required or not (in the method overview list):
```py
bool _can_import_threaded() virtual const
int _get_format_version() virtual const
Array[Dictionary] _get_import_options(path: String, preset_index: int) virtual const
int _get_import_order() virtual const
String _get_importer_name() virtual const
bool _get_option_visibility(path: String, option_name: StringName, options: Dictionary) virtual const
int _get_preset_count() virtual const
String _get_preset_name(preset_index: int) virtual const
float _get_priority() virtual const
PackedStringArray _get_recognized_extensions() virtual const
String _get_resource_type() virtual const
String _get_save_extension() virtual const
String _get_visible_name() virtual const
Error _import(source_file: String, save_path: String, options: Dictionary,
      platform_variants: Array[String], gen_files: Array[String]) virtual const
Error append_import_external_resource(path: String, custom_options: Dictionary = {},
      custom_importer: String = "", generator_parameters: Variant = null)
```
Without the example (turns out it is outdated), I have no clue which of the virtual methods are needed and which are only optional to customize some behavior. Even in the example, or anywhere on the docs page, it is never explicitly stated that these methods are required.
Them being required would be indicated in the documentation, but the error message also communicates that it is required by showing an error saying it is required

Status:
- Missing: No documentation for the whole class
- Not mentioned: Description has no mention whether you need to implement the method, or mentions any overrides
- Unclear: "Override this method to customize", "overridable method", or similar; the same language is used for methods that are optional to override
- Wrong suggestion: Language indicates **can** be overridden, but **must** be overridden
- Incorrect default: Documentation has a default value, but the method needs to be implemented
- In details: Detailed method description states must be overridden
- In class: Class description states must be implemented
- Full class: All virtual methods on the class `VirtualShaderNodeCustom` are marked as **optional** or **required** in the method details

In most places the documentation is lacking (I would ignore the fully missing documentation, it is clear that is work in progress). I like the way it is done on the `VirtualShaderNodeCustom` class, where it is clear for every virtual method (even if it would be nicer to see this information at a glance).
That should be a dedicated tracker IMO
